subject: Permission to Publish Joint Success Blurb — tradeoff for pricing addendum
messages:
From: Katie Morris <katie@brightfin.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketing@brightfin.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short joint blurb + logo usage in exchange for pricing addendum

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We’re close to sign but procurement pushed back on the list price for the annual commitment. Our marketing team is offering a short joint success blurb and permission to use BrightFin’s logo on Redwood’s website + a one-paragraph case vignette for a customer story if Redwood can make a small pricing concession for a net-new pilot cohort.

Specifically: BrightFin would provide an approved 40–60 word marketing blurb, a high-res logo, and an interview with their CPO for a short quote. In return they are asking for a 20% one-year discount on the first annual term (applied as an addendum to the SOW).

I’ve attached a short spec of their marketing ask (BrightFin_mark_usage_spec.pdf). Would you be able to confirm whether Redwood can accept this tradeoff? If so we’ll surface the assets and sign the addendum quickly.

Best,
Katie Morris
Head of Partnerships, BrightFin Analytics
Attachments: BrightFin_mark_usage_spec.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Morris <katie@brightfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short joint blurb + logo usage in exchange for pricing addendum

Hi Katie —

Really appreciate the proposal and for moving the procurement needle. I’d like to loop in our deal desk and legal to confirm the concession and marketing terms. Marissa / Vivek / Aditya — quick read: BrightFin is ready to provide a 40–60 word blurb, logo, and a CPO quote in exchange for a 20% discount applied as an addendum for year one (deal BD-2026-1127). BrightFin’s marketing spec is attached.

Key asks:
- Confirm if marketing can accept the requested logo usage and one-paragraph vignette (Aditya).
- Deal desk: confirm whether 20% one-year discount is within delegated authority or requires exec approval (Marissa).
- Legal: confirm there are no publicity or customer approval clauses we need to add to the SOW/addendum; and whether we should require a short review period for the blurb (Vivek).

If possible I’d like a decision by EOD tomorrow — they’re ready to sign once we can confirm.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short joint blurb + logo usage in exchange for pricing addendum

Thanks for the ping, Evelyn. Quick read from deal desk: 20% on an annual first term is above my standard delegated discount for this deal size (projected ARR $320k). I can approve up to 12% without exec sign-off. Anything above that needs either (a) Sales Director approval + documented marketing consideration, or (b) VP / CRO approval if material to renewals.

Given BrightFin is offering marketing assets, we can treat this as a marketing-concession trade. If Marketing (Aditya) confirms the value (needed channels, exclusivity, timelines), I can probable escalate to Sales Director for a one-off approval. Please confirm that the assets are public and evergreen (or provide a max reuse term).

Also request that the addendum include:
- A clause that the customer grants non-exclusive, revocable rights to use the BrightFin logo and provided blurb on Redwood’s website and marketing materials.
- A short approval turnaround on final copy (48 hours).

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short joint blurb + logo usage in exchange for pricing addendum

Folks —

Marketing is generally supportive provided a few constraints:
- No exclusivity (BrightFin can still work with competitors)
- Logo usage limited to website, sales collateral, and social (no press release co-issue unless separately approved)
- 12-month usage term for the blurb and logo, with option to renew.
- Marketing needs right to request minor copy edits; customer has 48 hours to approve.

If the 20% concession is limited to year one only and we document the above constraints in the addendum, marketing values this at ~$$$ (we’ll estimate media value after they share distribution plan). We can also offer a moderated caption style (customer-approved quote) rather than a long case study to streamline approvals.

I’ll piggyback on the deal desk escalation if you want me to prepare a short value memo for director approval.

—Aditya
Senior Manager, Marketing Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short joint blurb + logo usage in exchange for pricing addendum

Evelyn / team —

Legal review: No red flags so long as the following are included in the SOW/addendum:
1) A non-exclusive license for the customer logo and supplied blurb limited to the specified channels and a 12-month term (or different term if mutually agreed).
2) A Customer Approval process: Redwood must send final blurb/crop/logo usage to BrightFin; customer has 48 hours to approve. If no response, default to deemed approved after 72 hours to avoid blocking launches.
3) A limited indemnity carveout — we won’t use the customer’s IP beyond the granted license and they warrant they have the right to grant the logo/quote.

If Deal Desk escalates to Director I recommend a one-page memo capturing the marketing value and the narrow license terms; otherwise this requires VP sign-off for the 20% concession on the projected ARR. Happy to draft the addendum language and the approval flow.

Vivek
General Counsel (acting) | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short joint blurb + logo usage in exchange for pricing addendum

Team —

Decision path: I’ve escalated to Sales Director (cc’d via internal ticket) and recommended we approve a 20% one-year concession conditional on: marketing constraints as stated by Aditya, legal language as proposed by Vivek, and a signed addendum with the exact effective dates. Director prefers the concession to be tracked as a one-time, non-recurring discount line-item to avoid comp plan impact.

Evelyn — please confirm BrightFin is okay with: 12-month usage, 48-hour approval window (deemed approved after 72), and logo usage limited to website/sales collateral/social. If they accept, I’ll obtain Director sign-off and MarCom will prep a short memo for records.

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
